responses.explanation: The evidence provided in ORV-0018#P8 indicates that the net value loss for Midgard's wheat imports is close to 40% when accounting for substitute supplies from Vanir. This suggests a more severe impact than I previously claimed.
The assertion that Midgard lost only 37.4-41.4% of its wheat imports is indeed misleading, as ORV-0018#P8 confirms a net value loss closer to 40%, indicating a more severe impact.
My claim regarding Tolan's wheat import loss of only 28.3-34.2% does not hold up against the evidence in ORV-0018#P8, which shows that the net value loss for wheat is significantly higher.
